info.title: RWRentApi.Api | v1
info.description: Runtime-generated frontend contract for the V6 API. Authentication uses the cookieAuth security scheme. Unsafe requests carrying the authentication cookie require the antiforgery header documented per operation; obtain the paired cookie and in-memory request token from GET /api/auth/antiforgery. Enums are serialized as numeric values with x-enumNames mappings.

get.description: Returns healthy after the normally configured API host has started. Access: anonymous; no authentication is required.

get.summary: List the admitted user directory and reviewable registrations
get.description: Returns a no-tracking paged list. Search covers first name, last name, email, and phone; status and role are optional numeric-enum filters. Viewer visibility is limited to the admitted Company directory, while registration reviewers can see lifecycle records. Access: persistent cookie-authenticated user. Required authorization policies: Users.ReadDirectory.
